editorial_thesis: The next durable advantage is not more autonomous behavior; it is the operating evidence that makes autonomy safe to adopt, cheaper to run, and easier to correct.

topic_groups.title: Agent Runtime: Trace the Work, Not Just the Request
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Fresh practical signal in a coverage gap; selected for direct Buildn/client leverage and non-repetition versus the 2026-08-29 dossier.

sources.title: Cloudflare Agents
sources.why_selected: A hosted-agent layer built around live tracing, session replay, model/tool spans, approvals, and cost metadata.
sources.usefulness: Payload recording depends on the harness; privacy settings must be explicit before collecting messages.

sources.title: Local tracing for Workers
sources.why_selected: Cloudflare’s local tracing work brings production-like distributed traces into development.
sources.usefulness: A trace is evidence, not a correctness proof; pair it with task-level evals.

sources.title: Billable Usage API
sources.why_selected: A programmable usage and cost surface for Cloudflare self-serve products.
sources.usefulness: Provider billing dimensions may not map cleanly to business outcomes.

sources.title: Workers RPC across Python and JavaScript
sources.why_selected: Direct communication between Python and JavaScript Workers.
sources.usefulness: Cross-runtime contracts still need schema, timeout, and observability discipline.

sources.title: Computer-oriented agent runtime
sources.why_selected: An environment-selection model that treats a computer, filesystem, shell, and packages as first-class agent infrastructure.
sources.usefulness: More capability increases blast radius; isolation and egress policy are prerequisites.

topic_groups.title: Agent Access: Bind Authority to the Task
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Fresh practical signal in a coverage gap; selected for direct Buildn/client leverage and non-repetition versus the 2026-08-29 dossier.

sources.title: Agent Access Model
sources.why_selected: Cloudflare’s proposed model binds short-lived credentials and least privilege to a task execution graph.
sources.usefulness: This is a proposed architecture, not a universal standard; map it to the client’s IAM stack.

sources.title: Codex Security
sources.why_selected: An application-security agent combining project threat models, sandboxed validation, context-aware patches, and feedback.
sources.usefulness: Research-preview claims and supported environments require independent validation.

sources.title: Open Secure AI Alliance / SAFE
sources.why_selected: An industry collaboration around cybersecurity transparency, agent runtime controls, verified skills, identity, and production evaluation.
sources.usefulness: Alliance guidance and projects vary in maturity and interoperability.

sources.title: State of AI Agent Security 2026
sources.why_selected: A current survey/report highlighting low coverage of deployed-agent monitoring and uneven security practice.
sources.usefulness: Vendor research can include sampling and definition bias; treat the exact percentages as directional.

sources.title: Monitoring internal coding agents for misalignment
sources.why_selected: OpenAI describes monitoring patterns for detecting and understanding misaligned behavior in coding agents.
sources.usefulness: Internal monitoring methods may not transfer directly to small teams.

topic_groups.title: Long-Term Memory: Store Evidence, Not Just Context
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Fresh practical signal in a coverage gap; selected for direct Buildn/client leverage and non-repetition versus the 2026-08-29 dossier.

sources.title: Titans + MIRAS
sources.why_selected: Google Research presents a long-term memory architecture and framework using selective, surprise-driven updates during inference.
sources.usefulness: Research architecture is not a drop-in agent-memory product.

sources.title: Differentiated memory for scientific cognition
sources.why_selected: A 2026 framework proposal arguing that research agents need differentiated memory types for scientific work.
sources.usefulness: Framework proposals need empirical validation and careful schema design.

sources.title: Evidence-linked retrieval
sources.why_selected: A practical design pattern: retrieve claims with source, timestamp, confidence, and update path rather than naked text snippets.
sources.usefulness: Provenance itself can become stale and needs refresh policy.

sources.title: Forgetting as a product decision
sources.why_selected: Selective forgetting treats outdated, low-value, or contradicted state as a first-class lifecycle event.
sources.usefulness: Automatic forgetting can remove useful context; preserve an audit trail where appropriate.

sources.title: Memory evaluation loop
sources.why_selected: Evaluate memory by downstream task improvement and correction cost, not by recall alone.
sources.usefulness: Metrics need a task-specific baseline and can be gamed by over-retention.
